claims.name: AutoShip AI
claims.claim: "Our AI catches bad releases in under 30 seconds."
claims.measured: Median 2 min 08 s. Fastest run: 1 min 14 s. None under 30 s.

claims.name: OpenDeploy
claims.measured: First deploy in 6 min, true. Production-ready for 20 services: 2.5 engineer-days.

claims.name: FlagWorks
claims.claim: "Instant kill switch. Turn off any feature in milliseconds."
claims.measured: 1.8 s on servers, true. But a bad config can't be flagged off: manual rollback took 11 min.

claims.name: KubeRoll
claims.measured: Caught only 4 of 10 slow-building problems with default settings.

claims.name: MegaSuite
claims.claim: "Safe deployments, built into the platform you already own."
claims.measured: No automatic rollback. A human took a median 17 min to roll back.

claims.name: ChangeDesk
claims.measured: Auto-approvals took a median 4 min; high-risk changes waited 26 hours for the change board.
